QueryString.value: SELECT Project, Package, Version, PropertyName, argMax(EntityType, _created_at) AS EntityType, argMax(Description, _created_at) AS Description, argMax(PropertyType, _created_at) AS PropertyType, argMax(ScalarType, _created_at) AS ScalarType, argMax(IsMandatory, _created_at) AS IsMandatory, argMax(IsIndexed, _created_at) AS IsIndexed, argMax(IsHistoryEnabled, _created_at) AS IsHistoryEnabled, argMax(IsArray, _created_at) AS IsArray, max(_created_at) AS LastAudited FROM ( SELECT Enterprise_Name AS Project, Site_Name AS Package, Facility_Name AS Version, Resource_Name AS PropertyName, _created_at, JSONExtractString(Content, 'EntityType') AS EntityType, JSONExtractString(Content, 'Description') AS Description, JSONExtractString(Content, 'PropertyType') AS PropertyType, JSONExtractString(Content, 'ScalarType') AS ScalarType, JSONExtractString(Content, 'IsMandatory') AS IsMandatory, JSONExtractString(Content, 'IsIndexed') AS IsIndexed, JSONExtractString(Content, 'IsHistoryEnable') AS IsHistoryEnabled, JSONExtractString(Content, 'IsArray') AS IsArray FROM ( SELECT Enterprise_Name, Site_Name, Facility_Name, Resource_Name, _created_at, Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'Content')][1] AS Content FROM PostTelemetry WHERE Area_Name = '<SM>EntityTypeProperty' ) ) GROUP BY Project, Package, Version, PropertyName ORDER BY Project, Package, Version, EntityType, PropertyName
